> [!IMPORTANT]
> This PR needs two PRs that must merge first: [rocm-libraries#14634](https://github.com/ROCm/rocm-libraries/pull/14634), which lets CK's MoE GEMM pad N and K inside the kernel, and [AITER#7129](https://github.com/ROCm/aiter/pull/7129), which uses it for these sizes. vLLM's ROCm image also needs an AITER build that includes both. Until then, the tests this PR adds fail with AITER on.

## Overview

**NOTE**: This is an AITER ON PR.  The overall goal to make a step towards enabling AITER being turned on for vLLM by default.

With AITER enabled (`VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER=1`), these MI300 and MI355 tests fail:

| Test group | Test | GSM8K |
|---|---|---|
| (MI300) LM Eval Small Models | `test_gsm8k_correctness[DeepSeek-V2-Lite-Instruct-FP8]` | 0.0000 |
| (MI300) LM Eval Small Models Distributed | `test_gsm8k_correctness[DeepSeek-V2-Lite-Instruct-FP8]` | 0.0000 |
| (MI355) LM Eval Small Models Distributed | `test_gsm8k_correctness[DeepSeek-V2-Lite-Instruct-FP8]` | 0.0000 |
| (MI355) LM Eval Small Models Distributed | `test_gsm8k_correctness[DiffusionGemma-26B-A4B-it-FP8-dynamic]` | server fails to start |

The listed test groups and failures were observed:

* `(MI300) LM Eval Small Models`
    * `test_gsm8k_correctness[DeepSeek-V2-Lite-Instruct-FP8]`:
      ```
      (EngineCore pid=8384) ERROR 09-25 23:01:11 [core.py:1438] RuntimeError: wrong! device_gemm with the specified compilation parameters does not support this GEMM problem
      (APIServer pid=8097) ERROR 09-25 23:01:11 [async_llm.py:871] vllm.v1.engine.exceptions.EngineDeadError: EngineCore encountered an issue. See stack trace (above) for the root cause.
      FAILED evals/gsm8k/test_gsm8k_correctness.py::test_gsm8k_correctness[DeepSeek-V2-Lite-Instruct-FP8] - AssertionError: GSM8K metric too low: 0.0000 < 0.7200 - 0.0800 = 0.6400
      ```
* `(MI300) LM Eval Small Models Distributed`
    * `test_gsm8k_correctness[DeepSeek-V2-Lite-Instruct-FP8]`:
      ```
      (EngineCore pid=7516) ERROR 09-25 23:11:07 [core.py:1438] RuntimeError: wrong! device_gemm with the specified compilation parameters does not support this GEMM problem
      (APIServer pid=7229) ERROR 09-25 23:11:07 [async_llm.py:871] vllm.v1.engine.exceptions.EngineDeadError: EngineCore encountered an issue. See stack trace (above) for the root cause.
      FAILED evals/gsm8k/test_gsm8k_correctness.py::test_gsm8k_correctness[DeepSeek-V2-Lite-Instruct-FP8] - AssertionError: GSM8K metric too low: 0.0000 < 0.7200 - 0.0800 = 0.6400
      ```
* `(MI355) LM Eval Small Models Distributed`
    * `test_gsm8k_correctness[DeepSeek-V2-Lite-Instruct-FP8]`:
      ```
      (EngineCore pid=7640) ERROR 09-25 22:56:12 [core.py:1438] RuntimeError: wrong! device_gemm with the specified compilation parameters does not support this GEMM problem
      (APIServer pid=7353) ERROR 09-25 22:56:12 [async_llm.py:871] vllm.v1.engine.exceptions.EngineDeadError: EngineCore encountered an issue. See stack trace (above) for the root cause.
      FAILED evals/gsm8k/test_gsm8k_correctness.py::test_gsm8k_correctness[DeepSeek-V2-Lite-Instruct-FP8] - AssertionError: GSM8K metric too low: 0.0000 < 0.7200 - 0.0800 = 0.6400
      ```
    * `test_gsm8k_correctness[DiffusionGemma-26B-A4B-it-FP8-dynamic]`:
      ```
      (Worker_TP0 pid=11142) ERROR 10-09 09:03:23 [multiproc_executor.py:948] ValueError: FP8 MoE backend AITER does not support the deployment configuration since kernel does not support MoEActivation.GELU_TANH activation.
      (Worker_TP1 pid=11143) ERROR 10-09 09:03:24 [multiproc_executor.py:948] ValueError: FP8 MoE backend AITER does not support the deployment configuration since kernel does not support MoEActivation.GELU_TANH activation.
      RuntimeError: Engine core initialization failed. See root cause above. Failed core proc(s): {'EngineCore': 1}
      FAILED evals/gsm8k/test_gsm8k_correctness.py::test_gsm8k_correctness[DiffusionGemma-26B-A4B-it-FP8-dynamic] - RuntimeError: Server exited unexpectedly.
      ```

The following related models were also failing when running `vllm serve`:

* `nm-testing/DeepSeek-Coder-V2-Lite-Instruct-FP8` (compressed-tensors, `CompressedTensorsW8A8Fp8MoEMethod`)
    * TP1:
      ```
      (EngineCore pid=209763) ERROR 10-09 07:08:25 [core.py:1447] RuntimeError: wrong! device_gemm with the specified compilation parameters does not support this GEMM problem
      RuntimeError: Engine core initialization failed. See root cause above. Failed core proc(s): {}
      ```
* `amd/Qwen3-30B-A3B-Thinking-2507-FP8` (Quark, `QuarkW8A8Fp8MoEMethod`)
    * TP2:
      ```
      (Worker_TP0 pid=215695) ERROR 10-09 07:15:34 [multiproc_executor.py:1058] RuntimeError: wrong! device_gemm with the specified compilation parameters does not support this GEMM problem
      (Worker_TP1 pid=215696) ERROR 10-09 07:15:34 [multiproc_executor.py:1058] RuntimeError: wrong! device_gemm with the specified compilation parameters does not support this GEMM problem
      (EngineCore pid=215314) ERROR 10-09 07:15:34 [core.py:1447] RuntimeError: Worker failed with error 'wrong! device_gemm with the specified compilation parameters does not support this GEMM problem', please check the stack trace above for the root cause
      RuntimeError: Engine core initialization failed. See root cause above. Failed core proc(s): {}
      ```

All four models fail for the same reason. AITER's FP8 MoE kernel only supports sizes that are multiples of its tile size: the hidden size must be a multiple of 128, and the intermediate size per GPU a multiple of 256 (128 for SwiGLU). Each
of these models has an intermediate size that isn't:

| Model | Class | TP | Intermediate size per GPU |
|---|---|---|---|
| RedHatAI/DeepSeek-Coder-V2-Lite-Instruct-FP8 | `Fp8MoEMethod` | 1 | 1408 |
| nm-testing/DeepSeek-Coder-V2-Lite-Instruct-FP8 | `CompressedTensorsW8A8Fp8MoEMethod` | 1 | 1408 |
| amd/Qwen3-30B-A3B-Thinking-2507-FP8 | `QuarkW8A8Fp8MoEMethod` | 2 | 384 |
| RedHatAI/diffusiongemma-26B-A4B-it-FP8-dynamic | `CompressedTensorsW8A8Fp8MoEMethod` | 2 | 352 |

The fix for these sizes is in AITER and CK, so vLLM does not pad the weights. The CK change lets its MoE GEMM pad N and K inside the kernel ([rocm-libraries#14634](https://github.com/ROCm/rocm-libraries/pull/14634)), and the AITER change adds padded kernel instances and picks them for these sizes ([AITER#7129](https://github.com/ROCm/aiter/pull/7129)).

This PR needs an AITER build with both changes. An earlier version of this PR padded the weights in vLLM, and that padding is now removed.

This PR adds the failing models to the GSM8K tests. DiffusionGemma also uses the `gelu_tanh` activation, which vLLM did not pass to AITER even though AITER supports it. This PR passes it through for per-tensor and per-channel FP8, the
cases that AITER implements.

## Claims

- With the AITER and CK changes, the failing models pass with AITER on and AITER off, on MI300X and MI355X.
- The failing models are added to the tests and produce passing `lm_eval` scores.
- The failing models can run `vllm serve` and `vllm bench serve` with AITER on and AITER off.

> [!IMPORTANT]
> This PR needs two PRs that must merge first: [rocm-libraries#14634](https://github.com/ROCm/rocm-libraries/pull/14634), which lets CK's MoE GEMM pad N and K inside the kernel, and [AITER#7129](https://github.com/ROCm/aiter/pull/7129), which uses it for these sizes. vLLM's ROCm image also needs an AITER build that includes both. Until then, the tests this PR adds fail with AITER on.

## Overview

**NOTE**: This is an AITER ON PR.  The overall goal to make a step towards enabling AITER being turned on for vLLM by default.

With AITER enabled (`VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER=1`), these MI300 and MI355 tests fail:

| Test group | Test | GSM8K |
|---|---|---|
| (MI300) LM Eval Small Models | `test_gsm8k_correctness[DeepSeek-V2-Lite-Instruct-FP8]` | 0.0000 |
| (MI300) LM Eval Small Models Distributed | `test_gsm8k_correctness[DeepSeek-V2-Lite-Instruct-FP8]` | 0.0000 |
| (MI355) LM Eval Small Models Distributed | `test_gsm8k_correctness[DeepSeek-V2-Lite-Instruct-FP8]` | 0.0000 |
| (MI355) LM Eval Small Models Distributed | `test_gsm8k_correctness[DiffusionGemma-26B-A4B-it-FP8-dynamic]` | server fails to start |

The listed test groups and failures were observed:

* `(MI300) LM Eval Small Models`
    * `test_gsm8k_correctness[DeepSeek-V2-Lite-Instruct-FP8]`:
      ```
      (EngineCore pid=8384) ERROR 09-25 23:01:11 [core.py:1438] RuntimeError: wrong! device_gemm with the specified compilation parameters does not support this GEMM problem
      (APIServer pid=8097) ERROR 09-25 23:01:11 [async_llm.py:871] vllm.v1.engine.exceptions.EngineDeadError: EngineCore encountered an issue. See stack trace (above) for the root cause.

* `(MI300) LM Eval Small Models Distributed`

      (EngineCore pid=7516) ERROR 09-25 23:11:07 [core.py:1438] RuntimeError: wrong! device_gemm with the specified compilation parameters does not support this GEMM problem
      (APIServer pid=7229) ERROR 09-25 23:11:07 [async_llm.py:871] vllm.v1.engine.exceptions.EngineDeadError: EngineCore encountered an issue. See stack trace (above) for the root cause.
      FAILED evals/gsm8k/test_gsm8k_correctness.py::test_gsm8k_correctness[DeepSeek-V2-Lite-Instruct-FP8] - AssertionError: GSM8K metric too low: 0.0000 < 0.7200 - 0.0800 = 0.6400

      ```
      (Worker_TP0 pid=11142) ERROR 10-09 09:03:23 [multiproc_executor.py:948] ValueError: FP8 MoE backend AITER does not support the deployment configuration since kernel does not support MoEActivation.GELU_TANH activation.

The following related models were also failing when running `vllm serve`:

* `nm-testing/DeepSeek-Coder-V2-Lite-Instruct-FP8` (compressed-tensors, `CompressedTensorsW8A8Fp8MoEMethod`)
    * TP1:
      ```
      (EngineCore pid=209763) ERROR 10-09 07:08:25 [core.py:1447] RuntimeError: wrong! device_gemm with the specified compilation parameters does not support this GEMM problem
      RuntimeError: Engine core initialization failed. See root cause above. Failed core proc(s): {}
      ```
* `amd/Qwen3-30B-A3B-Thinking-2507-FP8` (Quark, `QuarkW8A8Fp8MoEMethod`)
    * TP2:
      ```
      (Worker_TP0 pid=215695) ERROR 10-09 07:15:34 [multiproc_executor.py:1058] RuntimeError: wrong! device_gemm with the specified compilation parameters does not support this GEMM problem
      (Worker_TP1 pid=215696) ERROR 10-09 07:15:34 [multiproc_executor.py:1058] RuntimeError: wrong! device_gemm with the specified compilation parameters does not support this GEMM problem
      (EngineCore pid=215314) ERROR 10-09 07:15:34 [core.py:1447] RuntimeError: Worker failed with error 'wrong! device_gemm with the specified compilation parameters does not support this GEMM problem', please check the stack trace above for the root cause
      RuntimeError: Engine core initialization failed. See root cause above. Failed core proc(s): {}
      ```

All four models fail for the same reason. AITER's FP8 MoE kernel only supports sizes that are multiples of its tile size: the hidden size must be a multiple of 128, and the intermediate size per GPU a multiple of 256 (128 for SwiGLU). Each
of these models has an intermediate size that isn't:

| Model | Class | TP | Intermediate size per GPU |
|---|---|---|---|
| RedHatAI/DeepSeek-Coder-V2-Lite-Instruct-FP8 | `Fp8MoEMethod` | 1 | 1408 |
| nm-testing/DeepSeek-Coder-V2-Lite-Instruct-FP8 | `CompressedTensorsW8A8Fp8MoEMethod` | 1 | 1408 |
| amd/Qwen3-30B-A3B-Thinking-2507-FP8 | `QuarkW8A8Fp8MoEMethod` | 2 | 384 |
| RedHatAI/diffusiongemma-26B-A4B-it-FP8-dynamic | `CompressedTensorsW8A8Fp8MoEMethod` | 2 | 352 |

The fix for these sizes is in AITER and CK, so vLLM does not pad the weights. The CK change lets its MoE GEMM pad N and K inside the kernel ([rocm-libraries#14634](https://github.com/ROCm/rocm-libraries/pull/14634)), and the AITER change adds padded kernel instances and picks them for these sizes ([AITER#7129](https://github.com/ROCm/aiter/pull/7129)).

This PR needs an AITER build with both changes. An earlier version of this PR padded the weights in vLLM, and that padding is now removed.

This PR adds the failing models to the GSM8K tests. DiffusionGemma also uses the `gelu_tanh` activation, which vLLM did not pass to AITER even though AITER supports it. This PR passes it through for per-tensor and per-channel FP8, the
cases that AITER implements.

## Claims

- With the AITER and CK changes, the failing models pass with AITER on and AITER off, on MI300X and MI355X.
- The failing models are added to the tests and produce passing `lm_eval` scores.
- The failing models can run `vllm serve` and `vllm bench serve` with AITER on and AITER off.
